content.text: Self-limiting medium & sm vessel necrotizing vasculitis incl
•surpasses ARF in industrialized countries · RF for ischemic Hdz in adults
: thought to be unidentified resp agent or viral pathogen w propensity towards vasc tissue
•eti unknown - hyperimmune rxn · autoimmune rxn · genetic predisposition also proposed
•MC 3mo-5yo - can occur in older children & adults
•genetics · advanced maternal age · maternal GBS colonization · early infancy hsp for bact illness
•begins as perineal erythema & desquamation → macular · morbilliform or targetoid lesions - ⍉vesicular
•presents w prolonged fever after nonspecific cough · rhinorrhea · diarrhea
•appears ill & inconsolable - often 1st dx as benign viral illness then cont to decline
ddx congenital Hdz: RF for dysrhythmias · IE · CHF · pulm HTN - ⍉RF for Kawasaki
: unexplained fever + <4 criteria + compatible labs or aneurysm on echo/angio - more common in infants & adults
•echo = imaging of choice for coronary a. aneurysm - @ dx · 1-2wks · 5-6wks after onset

•coronary a. abnormalities MC & most serious comp (dilate · aneurysm · stenosis) - ↑risk: >9yo or <1yo (esp <6mo) · male · late dx/delayed IVIG · long fever · IVIG-unresponsive · abnorm baseline coronary Z scores · markers of severe systemic inflam
•↑comp risk: fever >8d (most important predictor) · recurr fever after ≥48h afebrile · cardiomegaly · Asian · Pacific Islander · Hispanic
•hydrops of gallbladder: common GI comp - resolves w IVIG
•sensorineural hearing loss: acute phase - rarely persists - ← delayed IVIG · prolonged thrombocytosis · anemia · ↑ESR
•macrophage activation syndrome: rare - macrophage & T cell activate/prolif
for fever · joint pain & prev of ♡ comp
•IVIG w.in 1st 10d of illness + ASA concomitantly - start promptly once sus - vastly ↓comp risk
•IVIG = appropriate tx for children meeting criteria (⍉for SSSS)
•IVIG = only tx shown to prevent ♡ comp - ASA ⍉prevent aneurysm
•↑dose ASA (if ⍉CI) → ↓dose ASA 81-100mg/d after afebrile 48h - ↓inflam & PLT aggregation
•corticosteroids controversial - consider if ↑risk of ⍉response to 1st-line tx
•other anticoags besides ASA: clopidogrel · dipyridamole · warfarin · heparin
